content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (43c9a6c). The exec teeth-test (thermite-tv/tests/exec_teeth.rs) against the orchestrator E1-E4 fixtures: E1 cast-paren #122 (faithful (n-1) as u8 verified, infidel n-1 as u8 -> E0308), E2 cast-< #146 (faithful (x as u32)<33 verified, infidel -> mis-parse), E3 wrong-op/overflow (faithful a+b verified, wrapping_sub -> postcondition fail), E4 off-by-one index (xs[i] verified, xs[i+1] -> fail). The cross-crate bridge (exec_expr_tests in lower.rs) pins the faithful column to the REAL lower_exec_expr output so production drift turns it red. Critic confirmed the teeth bite generally.
